How Often Should You Train Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu?

September 28, 2026 · Cristyan BJJ Academy, Hyannis MA

One of the most common questions new students ask is how often they should come to class.

The beginner sweet spot

For most beginners, two to three classes per week gives enough repetition to learn while leaving time to recover.

Consistency beats intensity

Training twice a week for a year will get you much further than training every day for a month and then quitting.

Listen to your body

Soreness is normal at first. Sharp pain or lingering fatigue is a sign to rest.

Increasing frequency

Once your body adapts, many students add a third or fourth class. Mixing in open mat time can accelerate progress.

Fit training into your life

Cape Cod schedules change with the seasons. Find a routine you can stick to year-round, even during the busy summer.
